entries.title: Chat with friends and groups
entries.description: You can send direct messages, handle message requests, and start group chats. A chat dock keeps conversations nearby, with typing indicators while someone replies.

entries.title: Share links with previews
entries.description: You can see link previews in posts, threads, comments, and messages. GIF links display as images, and a link dialog helps you add links to posts.

entries.title: Print community invite cards
entries.description: You can download printable invite cards with permanent QR codes and turn their invite links on or off.

entries.title: See notifications as they arrive
entries.description: You can see notification popups while using Orbis without opening the notifications page.

entries.title: Choose what appears in your feed
entries.description: You can filter feeds by content type and switch to a compact view. You can also enter your current progress when adding a title to your library.

entries.title: Tours for the pages you visit
entries.description: You can get a short tour the first time you open communities, profiles, your library, and other key pages.

entries.title: Start and vote on discussions more easily
entries.description: You can write a new thread directly in the forum and use thumbs-up and thumbs-down voting. Your new threads start with your own upvote.

entries.title: Reach profiles from chat
entries.description: You can open someone’s profile from their name or avatar in an expanded chat and remove a friend from their profile.

entries.title: Animated loading and navigation
entries.description: You’ll see an animated Orbis logo while content loads and when you hover over the sidebar logo.

entries.title: Move communities between folders reliably
entries.description: You can drag communities out of folders and drop them into the intended place, with corrected drag previews and less empty space in the sidebar.

entries.title: Chat stays at the latest message
entries.description: Your chat stays at the bottom when its content changes size.
